dct_description_sm: The Southeastern Anglers Associations water quality project aims to monitor and protect a section of the Kent county watershed and the aquatic life within, encompassing the Cocagne, Bouctouche and Chockpish watersheds. Across the three watershed there are currently 9 Data loggers in place motioning temperature every hour. Basic water parameters are taken to asses the stress level of the aquatic life. Water samples are also taken and tested for E.coli, Nitrates and Phosphates associated with agriculture runoff and urbanization.
dct_title_s: SAA - Southeastern Anglers Association Water Quality
